name: Propagation of Affine Forms (PAF)
definition: A PAF is an affine combination of multiple unit random variables Zi, defined as X̂ = x0 + Σ(xi Zi), used to represent the distribution of values within a spatial region for uncertainty propagation through Implicit Neural Representations (INRs).
summary: Propagation of Affine Forms estimates Implicit Neural Representation output distributions by tracking probabilistic bounds through layers, yielding accurate soft bounds that improve hierarchical iso-surface extraction efficiency.
